title: 寒中見舞いの和風素材
subject_en: Japanese kanchu-mimai (midwinter greeting) motifs in Japanese ink-and-colour style, calm and quiet, snow on each subject, each a small complete object or scene Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 雪をかぶった南天・椿・雪うさぎ・手紙・湯のみなど、寒中見舞いに使える和の絵柄12点の素材です。喪中の返礼や、寒中見舞いはがきの飾りに向きます。
items: a nandina branch with red berries and snow on its leaves
a red camellia flower with glossy leaves and a cap of snow
a snow rabbit with red nandina berry eyes and two leaf ears on a small tray
a cluster of white narcissus flowers with long green leaves and snow at the base
a letter and an envelope with a pine twig beside them, tied with a thin cord
a Japanese tea cup with steam and a small tea sweet on a plate
a stone lantern with a cap of snow beside a small pine
a pine branch bending under snow
a golden Amur adonis flower coming up through snow
a small round snow figure with a bucket-like cap and a scarf, Japanese style
a kotatsu table with a quilt, a tea cup and a mandarin orange
a quiet snow-covered farmhouse with a thatched roof and smoke from its chimney
